text:
marta_support: FYI we've got a customer escalation — high 429s and tail latency on Dedicated for tenant acct-551. They see bursts of throttling even when their committed capacity should cover it.
ben_oncall: Can you paste a sample request/resp and a correlation id?
marta_support: Correlation id: c-id=6f2a9e. Sample header: `x-redwood-tenant: acct-551; x-tier: Gold`. Response: 429 with body `quota_exceeded: pool_assigned=shared_coldpool`.
raj_infra: Does routing policy consider `x-tier`? Our parser used to normalize case but recent control-plane change rolled out a stricter header matcher.
anna_support: @raj_infra this started after the 2026-03-03 control-plane deploy (commit 3a7f1d). Customer timeline matches.
deploy-bot: deploy 3a7f1d promoted to control-plane-prod @ 2026-03-03T11:07:22Z — config: routing/header-match-strict=true
ben_oncall: That would explain it. If tier label is "Gold" but policy expects "gold" it could fall through to default pool. Any logs?
marta_support: Attaching controller log excerpt: `route_decision tenant=acct-551 intended_pool=dedicated_pool_v12 selected_pool=shared_coldpool reason=header_mismatch("x-tier":"Gold")`. Also autoscaler scaled down dedicated_pool_v12 afterwards.
raj_infra: Oof. So two problems: (1) wrong pool selection because header matching is case-sensitive now, (2) autoscaler saw low utilization on dedicated_pool_v12 (because traffic routed elsewhere) and scaled it down, which tightened rate limits.
anna_support: Repro steps for eng: 1) send request with `x-redwood-tenant: acct-551` and `x-tier: Gold` 2) watch routing logs -> selected_pool=shared_coldpool 3) observe 429s once shared pool hits rate cap.
ryan_sre: Temporary mitigation: add a runtime rule that normalizes `x-tier` to lowercase before matching. Can we hotpatch routing filter?
raj_infra: We can add a fallback normalization in the header-matcher to accept case variants, but need a patch and quick rollout. I'll open a PR.
marta_support: Customer is asking for ETA and a manual workaround — they can lowercase header on their side but they want us to fix upstream.
ben_oncall: Can we also pin acct-551 to dedicated_pool_v12 as an emergency? That would bypass parsing for a bit.
raj_infra: We can create a tenant->pool binding in control plane mapping table. Risk: if pool actually overloaded it could still get throttled. But here dedicated_pool_v12 exists and is underutilized logically. I'll provision a binding and monitor.
anna_support: Please document the binding steps in the ticket so we can revert when root cause fixed.
raj_infra: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/ctrlplane/pulls/482 — adds case-insensitive header matcher and tests for `x-tier`. CI green.
deploy-bot: deploy candidate 3a7f1d+patch482 to canary @ 2026-03-04T02:15:10Z
ben_oncall: Roll canary, keep an eye on routing logs for acct-551. If canary looks good, promote.
rayam_sre: (typo) sorry ignore
ryan_sre: Canary looks clean — matched `x-tier: Gold` correctly to `gold` rule, selected_pool=dedicated_pool_v12. No regressions in other tenants observed in the canary window.
raj_infra: Promoting to prod now. deploy-bot: deploy 3a7f1d+patch482 to control-plane-prod @ 2026-03-04T02:42:31Z
marta_support: Customer confirmed traffic returned to dedicated_pool_v12 and 429s dropped to 0 in their sampling window. They still want an RCA and whether autoscaler will restore proper capacity.
ryan_sre: Autoscaler will gradually scale up if metrics show increased load. We should also backfill missed metrics and ensure cooldown period allows quick scale-up.
anna_support: Action items: - raj_infra: revert tenant->pool binding after stability (if binding created) - raj_infra: ensure header-matcher normalization unit tests remain - eng-sre: review autoscaler cooldown heuristics to avoid scale-down due to transient misroutes - support: send customer short RCA and apology
ben_oncall: Also add a monitoring alert for sudden pool-utilization divergence (dedicated pool expected_util > actual_received_traffic by > 50%) — would catch this earlier.
raj_infra: Created follow-up issues: #983 (hotfix verification), #984 (autoscaler cooldown review), #985 (monitoring alert).
marta_support: Thanks all. Customer says support thread is enough for now, will reopen if they see reoccurrence. :thumbsup:
ben_oncall: Closing loop: log snippet of root cause for ticket: `control-plane 3a7f1d made header matching strict -> case-sensitive. Requests with X-Tier: Gold fell through -> routed to shared_coldpool -> autoscaler scaled down dedicated_pool_v12 -> throttling observed.`
anna_support: We'll PR a short postmortem into incidents channel once we have timeline and metrics.
ryan_sre: One-liner mitigation checklist posted to internal runbook: "If tenant sees unexplained dedicated-throttles: check header-case mismatches, control-plane deploys, tenant bindings."
marta_support: Thread resolved for now. Will reopen if customer reports any more errors. :white_check_mark:
